The `line-height: 2` on `root` is a unitless multiplier, so it computes to `2 × 16px = 32px` for `root` itself. Unitless `line-height` is inherited as a multiplier rather than a length, so `root>big` computes its own line-height as `2 × 32px = 64px`. With one line of text at that size and no other height-affecting properties, the box renders at 64px tall, as confirmed by `getBoundingClientRect`.

ANSWER: 64
